title: Interruption-Aware Recurrent Reinforcement Learning for UAS Navigation Under Temporary Overrides
title_zh: 面向临时接管下无人机导航的中断感知循环强化学习

paragraphs.en: Safe autonomous navigation of unmanned aircraft systems (UASs) requires tactical deconfliction to address conflicts that strategic coordination cannot fully prevent. This task is challenging under partial observability, when sensor or traffic data are missing, delayed, or degraded. Geometry-based methods can offer separation assurances but face limitations in dense encounters. Recurrent reinforcement learning (RL) has therefore been proposed to learn navigation policies that integrate observation-action histories to optimise long-term safety-efficiency trade-offs. However, operational safeguards may require a remote pilot, onboard detect-and-avoid (DAA) system, or runtime assurance (RTA) mechanism to temporarily override the learned policy. A research gap remains in understanding how these interruptions affect recurrent policies when the agent regains authority. Benchmark evidence shows that interruptions make task variables less decodable from the recurrent hidden state and increase post-interruption collision risk. The findings suggest that altered recurrent context prolongs post-handback degradation through an action-observation feedback loop, in which changed actions alter the flight path and subsequent recurrent updates. To address this vulnerability, we propose three interruption-aware architectures that condition recurrent processing on interruption context through separate feature streams, dedicated interruption memory, or gated environmental features. Across simulations, all three architectures preserve more decodable task information than a standard recurrent policy. Moreover, the strongest architecture reduces post-interruption collisions by 74% and interruption-induced mission failures by 69% relative to the recurrent baseline, without degrading interruption-free performance. These results show that safe interruption does not guarantee safe handback, and support interruption-aware recurrent design for resilient UAS autonomy.
paragraphs.zh: 无人飞机系统（UAS）的安全自主导航需要战术去冲突，以应对战略协调无法完全预防的冲突。 在部分可观测条件下，当传感器或交通数据缺失、延迟或降级时，这一任务极具挑战性。 基于几何的方法可以提供间隔保证，但在密集遭遇场景中存在局限。 因此，研究者提出了循环强化学习（RL），以学习整合观测-动作历史的导航策略，从而优化长期的安全性与效率权衡。 然而，运行保障可能需要远程飞行员、机载探测与避让（DAA）系统或运行时保障（RTA）机制临时接管，覆盖已学习的策略。 当智能体重新获得控制权时，这些中断如何影响循环策略，目前仍存在研究空白。 基准实验证据表明，中断使任务变量更难从循环隐藏状态中解码，并增加了中断后的碰撞风险。 研究发现表明，改变的循环上下文通过动作-观测反馈回路延长了交还控制后的性能退化，在该回路中，变化的动作会改变飞行路径及随后的循环更新。 为应对这一脆弱性，我们提出三种中断感知架构，通过分离的特征流、专用的中断记忆或门控的环境特征，使循环处理以中断上下文为条件。 在多项仿真中，三种架构均比标准循环策略保留了更多可解码的任务信息。 此外，性能最强的架构相对于循环基线，将中断后碰撞减少了74%，将中断引发的任务失败减少了69%，且未降低无中断情况下的性能。 这些结果表明，安全的中断并不保证安全的控制交还，并为面向韧性UAS自主性的中断感知循环设计提供了支持。

paragraphs.en: Unmanned aircraft system (UAS) traffic management (UTM) frameworks support flight planning, strategic deconfliction and information exchange for UAS navigation [ 1 , 2 ] . Nonetheless, the UAS operator or remote pilot remains responsible for flight safety, and strategic coordination cannot eliminate every conflict that develops during a flight. Aircraft may deviate from their submitted intents, surveillance information may be delayed or degraded, and non-cooperative aircraft or other hazards may be absent from networked information. Tactical deconfliction is therefore required to address emerging conflicts and complement strategic UTM services [ 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 ] . Moreover, additional safeguards are required when the tactical navigation algorithm encounters unreliable information or conditions outside its validated operating envelope. An onboard detect-and-avoid (DAA) system, runtime-assurance (RTA) mechanism or remote pilot may temporarily override nominal autonomy to resolve an emerging hazard [ 3 , 4 , 7 , 8 , 9 , 5 ] . Additionally, interruptions may arise from command-and-control (C2) link disruptions or malicious cyberphysical interference [ 10 , 11 ] . The reliability of the nominal algorithm after it regains authority, hereby referred to as handback, is therefore part of the safety problem.
paragraphs.zh: 无人机系统（UAS）交通管理（UTM）框架支持无人机系统导航的飞行规划、战略去冲突和信息交换 [ 1 , 2 ] 。 尽管如此，无人机系统操作员或远程飞行员仍然对飞行安全负责，而且战略协调无法消除飞行过程中出现的所有冲突。 飞机可能偏离其提交的意图，监视信息可能延迟或质量下降，且不合作的飞机或其他危害可能未出现在联网信息中。 因此，需要战术去冲突来应对新出现的冲突，并与战略性的 UTM 服务形成互补 [ 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 ] 。 此外，当战术导航算法遇到不可靠的信息或超出其已验证运行包线的情况时，需要额外的安全保障。 机载探测与规避（DAA）系统、运行时保障（RTA）机制或远程飞行员可以临时接管名义自主性，以化解新出现的危害 [ 3 , 4 , 7 , 8 , 9 , 5 ] 。 另外，中断还可能由指挥与控制（C2）链路中断或恶意信息物理干扰引起 [ 10 , 11 ] 。 因此，名义算法在重新获得控制权后（此处称为交还）的可靠性也是安全问题的一部分。

paragraphs.en: Within this operational framework, tactical deconfliction has traditionally relied on geometry-based methods, including velocity-obstacle and potential-field algorithms [ 12 , 13 ] . These approaches often leverage rule-, search- or optimisation-based planning to provide predictable behaviour under explicit assumptions about aircraft dynamics, traffic behaviour and environmental conditions [ 14 , 15 ] . Advanced air mobility (AAM), however, will increase the volume, heterogeneity, and autonomy of aircraft in the airspace, creating denser and more uncertain traffic interactions [ 1 , 16 ] . These conditions make the behaviour of interacting aircraft harder to model and increase the computational cost of repeatedly solving multi-aircraft deconfliction problems online [ 14 , 15 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 在这一运行框架内，战术层面的去冲突传统上依赖于基于几何的方法，包括速度障碍算法和势场算法 [ 12 , 13 ] 。 这些方法通常利用基于规则、基于搜索或基于优化的规划，在对飞行器动力学、交通行为和环境条件作出明确假设的情况下提供可预测的行为 [ 14 , 15 ] 。 然而，先进空中交通（AAM）将增加空域中飞行器的数量、异构性和自主性，造成更密集、更不确定的交通交互 [ 1 , 16 ] 。 这些条件使得相互作用的飞行器的行为更难建模，并增加了在线反复求解多机去冲突问题的计算成本 [ 14 , 15 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) offers a complementary approach by learning navigation policies through simulated conflict encounters [ 17 ] . It can optimise safety-efficiency trade-offs while shifting much of the computational burden to offline training [ 18 , 19 , 20 , 21 ] . However, finite sensor coverage, noise, occlusion and degraded traffic information make tactical deconfliction partially observable [ 1 , 3 ] . Recurrent RL addresses this limitation by maintaining a hidden state that summarises task-relevant history to inform current decisions [ 22 , 23 , 24 ] . Notably, Lambrechts et al. [ 24 ] show that recurrent memory encodes information correlated with beliefs over latent task variables, with more informative representations resulting in better task performance. Recurrent memory can therefore be interpreted as a learned, task-dependent information state.
paragraphs.zh: 强化学习（RL）提供了一种互补的方法，通过在模拟冲突遭遇中学习导航策略 [ 17 ] 。 它可以在将大量计算负担转移到离线训练的同时，优化安全性与效率之间的权衡 [ 18 , 19 , 20 , 21 ] 。 然而，有限的传感器覆盖范围、噪声、遮挡以及退化的交通信息使得战术去冲突具有部分可观测性 [ 1 , 3 ] 。 循环强化学习通过维护一个隐状态来应对这一局限，该隐状态汇总与任务相关的历史信息，从而为当前决策提供依据 [ 22 , 23 , 24 ] 。 值得注意的是，Lambrechts 等人 [ 24 ] 表明，循环记忆编码的信息与对潜在任务变量的信念相关，且信息量更大的表示会带来更好的任务表现。 因此，循环记忆可以被解释为一个学习得到的、依赖于任务的信息状态。

paragraphs.en: Temporary overrides introduce a distinct challenge for recurrent policies. During an interruption, the policy’s proposed actions are not executed, yet its recurrent state evolves with observations generated by externally selected manoeuvres. This altered context can make task-relevant information less accessible or distort how carried information influences subsequent decisions. Consequently, an interruption that resolves an immediate hazard does not necessarily ensure safe handback.
paragraphs.zh: 临时覆盖为循环策略带来了一个独特的挑战。 在中断期间，策略所提议的动作不会被执行，但其循环状态会随着由外部选择的机动所产生的观测而演化。 这种被改变的上下文可能使与任务相关的信息更难获取，或扭曲所携带信息对后续决策的影响方式。 因此，解决了当前紧急危险的中断并不一定能确保安全的交还。

paragraphs.en: Table I summarises existing research relevant to interrupting recurrent navigation policies. Transportation research examines transitions between automated systems and human decision-makers, focusing on improving override timing and operator readiness [ 25 , 26 , 27 ] . In UTM and other safety-critical autonomous systems, DAA and RTA research instead addresses better hazard detection, safety monitoring, and recovery behaviour [ 3 , 4 , 7 , 8 , 9 , 5 ] . Within RL, research primarily addresses the safety of learned behaviour and responsiveness to interruptions. Safe RL incorporates risk measures or safety constraints during training, whereas shielded RL masks or replaces actions that violate safety thresholds [ 29 , 30 , 31 ] . Corrigibility targets agents that accept or assist external corrections without manipulating the correcting authority [ 33 , 34 , 35 ] . Specifically, safely interruptible RL addresses how interruptions affect learning, developing algorithms that avoid seeking out or preventing future interruptions [ 32 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 表I总结了与中断循环导航策略相关的现有研究。 交通领域的研究考察了自动化系统与人类决策者之间的切换，重点在于改进接管时机与操作者准备状态 [ 25 , 26 , 27 ] 。 在UTM及其他安全关键型自主系统中，DAA与RTA研究则侧重于更好的危险检测、安全监控和恢复行为 [ 3 , 4 , 7 , 8 , 9 , 5 ] 。 在强化学习领域，研究主要关注已习得行为的安全性以及对中断的响应能力。 安全强化学习在训练过程中引入风险度量或安全约束，而屏蔽式强化学习则屏蔽或替换违反安全阈值的动作 [ 29 , 30 , 31 ] 。 可纠正性针对的是那些接受或协助外部纠正、且不会操控纠正权威的智能体 [ 33 , 34 , 35 ] 。 具体而言，安全可中断强化学习研究中断如何影响学习过程，并开发避免寻求或阻止未来中断的算法 [ 32 ] 。

sents.en: Specifically, safely interruptible RL addresses how interruptions affect learning, developing algorithms that avoid seeking out or preventing future interruptions [ 32 ] .
sents.zh: 具体而言，安全可中断强化学习研究中断如何影响学习过程，并开发避免寻求或阻止未来中断的算法 [ 32 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Action-modification research provides the closest formal abstraction of the interruptions considered in this paper. Langlois and Everitt [ 37 ] introduce the modified-action Markov decision process (MAMDP), which distinguishes the action selected by a policy from that ultimately executed following external modifications. Their analysis shows that some agents ignore modifications while others adapt their behaviour to avoid modifications that reduce reward. Human-in-the-loop RL also uses human overrides as demonstrations or feedback to improve policies during training [ 36 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 动作修改研究为本文所考虑的中断提供了最接近的形式化抽象。 Langlois 和 Everitt [ 37 ] 提出了修改动作马尔可夫决策过程（MAMDP），该方法将被策略选择的动作与在外部修改后最终执行的动作区分开来。 他们的分析表明，一些智能体忽略修改，而另一些智能体则调整自身行为以避免降低奖励的修改。 人在回路强化学习还利用人工干预作为示范或反馈，以便在训练过程中改进策略 [ 36 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Complementing these studies, recurrent RL has been applied to UAS navigation under partial observability [ 23 , 28 ] , while representation analysis examines which latent task variables are decodable from recurrent hidden states [ 24 , 39 ] . Influence-aware memory restricts recurrent inputs to variables relevant to unobserved environmental states, reducing interference from irrelevant features [ 38 ] . Recurrent independent mechanisms similarly organise memory into sparsely interacting modules to improve robustness to environmental changes [ 40 ] . These approaches inform the analysis of recurrent representations and the design of structured memory architectures.
paragraphs.zh: 作为对上述研究的补充，循环强化学习已被应用于部分可观测条件下的无人机系统导航 [ 23 , 28 ] ，而表征分析则考察哪些潜在任务变量可以从循环隐藏状态中解码出来 [ 24 , 39 ] 。 影响感知记忆将循环输入限制为与未观测环境状态相关的变量，从而减少无关特征造成的干扰 [ 38 ] 。 循环独立机制类似地将记忆组织为稀疏交互的模块，以提升对环境变化的鲁棒性 [ 40 ] 。 这些方法为循环表征的分析和结构化记忆架构的设计提供了借鉴。

paragraphs.en: Existing literature highlights why interruptions are needed, when they should be initiated, and how they affect policy learning. However, a safe interruption does not guarantee safe handback. A research gap remains in understanding how interruptions affect recurrent representations, how they influence post-handback performance, and how they should be accommodated by recurrent policies. We address this gap through the following contributions:
paragraphs.zh: 现有文献强调了为什么需要中断、何时应该启动中断，以及中断如何影响策略学习。 然而，安全的中断并不能保证安全的交还。 在理解中断如何影响循环表示、它们如何影响交还后的性能，以及循环策略应如何适应中断等方面，仍然存在研究空白。 我们通过以下贡献来弥补这一空白：

paragraphs.en: Interruption of recurrent UAS navigation is formulated as a handback reliability problem and modelled as a partially observable MAMDP (PO-MAMDP).
paragraphs.zh: 对循环无人机系统（UAS）导航的干扰被构建为一个交还可靠性问题，并建模为部分可观测的MAMDP（PO-MAMDP）。

paragraphs.en: A paired evaluation framework is developed to characterise the impact of interruptions across different trigger conditions, supervisor behaviours and override durations.
paragraphs.zh: 开发了一种配对评估框架，用于刻画不同触发条件、监督者行为和接管时长对中断的影响。

paragraphs.en: Interruptions are shown to reduce task-variable decodability from the recurrent hidden state, degrade agent performance and increase post-handback collision risk.
paragraphs.zh: 研究表明，中断会降低循环隐藏状态对任务变量的可解码性，降低智能体的性能，并增加交还后的碰撞风险。

paragraphs.en: Three interruption-aware recurrent architectures are proposed that demonstrate increased robustness to interruptions without degrading interruption-free performance.
paragraphs.zh: 提出了三种具备中断感知能力的循环架构，它们在对中断表现出更强鲁棒性的同时，不会降低无中断情况下的性能。

paragraphs.en: This study focuses on history-dependent tactical navigation under partial observability, as summarised in Table II . A single operator uses a nominal navigation policy to guide one UAS towards its destination while avoiding surrounding traffic and respecting operational constraints. The policy combines onboard sensor data with traffic and constraint information supplied through UTM services to generate navigation commands. It may run onboard, as illustrated in Fig. 1 , or in a command-and-control centre (C2C), with commands transmitted over the C2 link. In either configuration, an onboard DAA system, RTA mechanism or remote pilot may temporarily override the policy to resolve emerging threats [ 3 , 4 , 9 , 6 ] . Harmful overrides may also arise from malicious interference [ 11 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 本研究聚焦于部分可观测条件下依赖历史的战术导航问题，概要如表 II 所示。 单名操作员使用名义导航策略引导一架无人机系统（UAS）前往目的地，同时规避周边交通并遵守运行约束。 该策略将机载传感器数据与通过 UTM 服务提供的交通和约束信息相结合，以生成导航指令。 该策略可在机载运行（如图 1 所示），也可在指挥控制中心（C2C）运行，指令通过 C2 链路传输。 无论采用哪种配置，机载的探测与规避（DAA）系统、实时保障（RTA）机制或远程飞行员都可能临时接管该策略，以处置新出现的威胁 [3, 4, 9, 6]。 有害的接管也可能源于恶意干扰 [11]。

paragraphs.en: Start and destination positions are randomised in each episode. Moreover, surrounding traffic includes both intruders whose initial trajectories intersect the nominal start-destination path and intruders sampled elsewhere in the operating region, producing a range of direct and indirect encounters. paragraphs.en: Several RL algorithms have been applied to UAS navigation under partial observability [ 23 , 28 ] . Among policy-gradient methods, proximal policy optimisation (PPO) is particularly suitable because it enables several minibatch updates from each collected rollout and discourages excessively large policy changes through a clipped surrogate objective [ 46 ] . Unlike value-based methods such as deep Q-learning, PPO can represent continuous actions without discretising the action space [ 47 ] . It also directly represents a stochastic policy, unlike deep deterministic policy gradient (DDPG) methods, and avoids the complex constrained optimisation required by trust-region policy optimisation (TRPO) [ 48 , 49 ] . A recurrent PPO agent therefore serves as the baseline policy for this work, to optimise a stochastic distribution over the continuous yaw-rate commands of the ego UAS described in Section II .
paragraphs.zh: 多种强化学习算法已被应用于部分可观测条件下的无人机系统导航 [ 23 , 28 ] 。 在策略梯度方法中，近端策略优化（PPO）尤为适用，因为它可以对每次采集的轨迹数据进行多次小批量更新，并通过裁剪的代理目标函数抑制过大的策略变化 [ 46 ] 。 与深度Q学习等基于价值的方法不同，PPO 无需对动作空间离散化即可表示连续动作 [ 47 ] 。 与深度确定性策略梯度（DDPG）方法不同，它还直接表示随机策略，并避免了信任域策略优化（TRPO）所需的复杂约束优化 [ 48 , 49 ] 。 因此，本工作采用循环 PPO 智能体作为基线策略，以优化第 II 节所述自机无人机系统连续偏航角速度指令上的随机分布。

paragraphs.en: Recurrent policies address partial observability by compressing the observation-action history into a learned information state that can encode task-relevant belief information [ 24 , 38 ] . In this work, long short-term memory (LSTM) networks are used because their gated cell structure supports information retention over longer temporal dependencies than an ungated recurrent neural network [ 51 ] . Although gated recurrent units (GRUs) offer a simpler gated alternative, LSTMs maintain a distinct cell state that provides an explicit pathway for longer-term information retention [ 52 ] . This separation is particularly useful for analysing how task-relevant memory changes during an interruption.
paragraphs.zh: 递归策略通过将观测-动作历史压缩为一个可学习的信息状态来解决部分可观测性问题，该状态能够编码与任务相关的信念信息 [24, 38]。 在本工作中，使用长短期记忆（LSTM）网络，因为其门控单元结构相比无门控的递归神经网络能够支持在更长的时间依赖上保留信息 [51]。 尽管门控递归单元（GRU）提供了一种更简单的门控替代方案，但 LSTM 维护着一个独立的细胞状态，为更长期的信息保留提供了显式通路 [52]。 这种分离对于分析中断期间与任务相关的记忆如何变化特别有用。

The environmental observation o t o_{t} describes the aircraft, surrounding traffic, destination, and environment. Although its measurements may be intermittent or degraded, the underlying physical state generally evolves continuously over time. Conversely, the interruption input u t u_{t} changes abruptly at an interruption trigger and upon handback. The recurrent agent must therefore construct a task-relevant belief for the evolving physical environment while also representing sparse changes in decision authority.
paragraphs.zh: 一种具备中断感知能力的策略接收两路性质截然不同的输入流。 环境观测 o t o_{t} 描述飞行器、周边交通、目的地以及环境。 尽管其测量可能是间歇性的或退化的，底层物理状态通常会随时间连续演化。 相反，中断输入 u t u_{t} 会在中断触发时以及交还控制时发生突变。 因此，循环智能体必须在为不断演化的物理环境构建与任务相关的信念的同时，还要表示决策权的稀疏变化。

sents.zh: 每个被选中的训练回合包含一个有边界的单一中断，其中断起始时间、持续时长和监督者行为均从预定义的分布中采样。

sents.en: The specific training schedule and sampling distributions are specified in Section IV .
sents.zh: 具体的训练计划与采样分布在第四节中给出。

paragraphs.en: During an interruption, the nominal actor continues to propose a t a_{t} and update its recurrent state, but the supervisor-selected action a ¯ t \bar{a}_{t} is executed. The resulting transition and reward cannot be attributed directly to a t a_{t} and assigning its PPO advantage to that proposal would train the actor using an action it did not execute. The actor advantage is hence masked after GAE in ( 25 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在中断期间，名义上的智能体仍继续提出动作 a_{t} 并更新其循环状态，但实际执行的是监督者选择的动作 \bar{a}_{t}。 由此产生的转移和奖励无法直接归因于 a_{t}，若将该动作的 PPO 优势分配给该提议，就等于用智能体并未执行的动作来训练它。 因此，在式 (25) 中经过 GAE 之后，智能体的优势被掩蔽。

sents.en: The actor advantage is hence masked after GAE in ( 25 ).
sents.zh: 因此，在式 (25) 中经过 GAE 之后，智能体的优势被掩蔽。

paragraphs.en: The masked advantage A ~ t \widetilde{A}_{t} is then used in the standard clipped PPO objective, so an interrupted step contributes no direct advantage-weighted policy gradient.
paragraphs.zh: 被掩蔽的优势 A ~ t \widetilde{A}_{t} 随后被用于标准的裁剪 PPO 目标函数中，因此被中断的步骤不会产生直接的、以优势加权的策略梯度。

paragraphs.en: The critic and entropy terms remain unmasked. The critic is trained against returns from the executed-action trajectory, while the entropy term continues to regularise the policy at all visited histories. Actor and critic recurrent states are also unrolled through supervisor-executed steps. Masking therefore prevents direct credit assignment to unexecuted proposals without discarding the interrupted trajectories required to train recurrent memory and value estimation.
paragraphs.zh: 评论家项和熵项保持不掩码。 评论家针对所执行动作轨迹的回报进行训练，而熵项则继续在所有访问过的历史处对策略进行正则化。 智能体的演员和评论家的循环状态也会通过监督者执行的步骤进行展开。 因此，掩码在不丢弃训练循环记忆与价值估计所需的中断轨迹的前提下，阻止了对未执行提案的直接信用分配。

paragraphs.en: Handcrafted: a heuristic supervisor that uses the same observation as the nominal policy. Intruder proximity is mapped to a set of turn commands that avoid collisions and track the observed goal bearing. This represents a simple on-board RTA system that uses the same observation as the nominal learning-based policy.
paragraphs.zh: 手工设计：一种启发式监控器，它使用与标称策略相同的观测。 入侵者的接近程度被映射为一组转向指令，以避免碰撞并跟踪观测到的目标方位。 这代表了一种简单的机载 RTA 系统，它使用与标称学习型策略相同的观测。

paragraphs.en: Antagonistic: an inverted oracular planner that steers away from the goal and towards the nearest intruder, subject to a hard floor that avoids an immediate collision. paragraphs.zh: 对抗型：一个反转的神谕规划器，它引导智能体远离目标并朝向最近的入侵者，同时受一个避免立即发生碰撞的硬性下限约束。 它测试的是对强烈偏离名义状态监督者的鲁棒性，并代表恶意行为者暂时夺取控制权的情形。

paragraphs.en: Matched simulation pairs are used to isolate interruptions from the effects of initial-condition and stochastic-traffic variability. paragraphs.en: State-triggered interruptions are evaluated using a max-separation supervisor that triggers when the nearest-intruder separation falls below 2 2 m and hands back after all intruders clear 3 3 m, subject to a maximum duration of 60 steps. A deterministic trigger is also implemented to consistently avoid collisions.
paragraphs.zh: 状态触发的中断通过一个最大间隔监督器进行评估，该监督器在最近入侵者间隔低于 2 2 米时触发，并在所有入侵者间隔超过 3 3 米后交还控制，同时最长持续时间为 60 步。 首先考虑一种概率触发器，其每步介入概率随间隔减小而增大，最大值为 0.6 0.6。 还实现了一种确定性触发器，以持续避免碰撞。

paragraphs.en: A probe may perform worse on interrupted-arm states because information is genuinely lost, corresponding to memory degradation. However, information may still be present but encoded differently after the interruption. To reduce sensitivity to such representational shifts, we leverage two additional metrics. The corrected gap directly subtracts the shift from the reference probe, measured as the additional error incurred by applying the reference probe to interrupted-arm states. The within-arm gap avoids the probe mismatch altogether by socring each arm using a probe fitted to that arm.
paragraphs.zh: 探针在被打断臂的状态上可能表现更差，因为信息确实丢失了，这对应于记忆退化。 然而，信息可能仍然存在，只是在被打断后以不同的方式编码。 为了降低对此类表征变化的敏感性，我们利用另外两个指标。 校正差距直接从参考探针中减去该偏移，该偏移被度量参考探针应用于被打断臂状态时产生的额外误差。 臂内差距则完全避免了探针不匹配的问题，它对每个臂使用拟合于该臂的探针来进行评分。

paragraphs.en: Experiments are evaluated using the following metrics, and uncertainty is reported as 95% confidence intervals. In all cases, pairs in which an arm collides during the interruption or within 15 steps of handback are excluded to avoid reflecting collisions caused by poor supervisor performance, or a supervisor directly handing back authority before a collision.
paragraphs.zh: 实验使用以下指标进行评估，不确定性以 95% 置信区间的形式报告。 在所有情况下，凡是机械臂在中断期间或交还控制权后的 15 步内发生碰撞的配对都会被排除，以避免反映出由监督者表现不佳导致的碰撞，或监督者在碰撞发生前直接交回控制权的情况。

paragraphs.en: Post-handback collision rate: the proportion of pairs in which the interrupted arm collides after handback, but the reference arm does not.
paragraphs.zh: 回交后碰撞率：在被回交后发生碰撞、而参考机械臂未发生碰撞的机械臂对所占的比例。

paragraphs.en: Lost-success rate: the proportion of pairs in which the interrupted arm fails, but the reference arm succeeds.
paragraphs.zh: 丢失成功率：被中断的臂失败但参考臂成功的配对所占的比例。

paragraphs.en: Collision and success rates: the unconditional proportion of episodes that collide or reach the destination.
paragraphs.zh: 碰撞率与成功率：发生碰撞或到达目的地的回合的无条件比例。

paragraphs.en: Belief degradation: the reduction in variable decodability between the reference and interrupted recurrent states, using the corrected or within-arm gap defined above.
paragraphs.zh: 信念退化：参考循环状态与被中断循环状态之间变量可解码性的降低，使用上文定义的修正差距或组内差距。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 4 compares the training curve of a memoryless multilayer perceptron (MLP) PPO agent [ 46 ] against the LSTM-based recurrent PPO baseline. Under the same training curriculum, the memoryless policy plateaus at a success rate of approximately 10% with three intruders and never reaches the 75% success threshold needed to progress the intruder curriculum. Conversely, the recurrent policy exceeds this threshold at every curriculum stage and progresses to the final ten-intruder setting. Its episode length also decreases as training progresses, consistent with a policy that generates increasingly efficient UAS trajectories. This confirms that recurrent memory is essential for effective navigation in the simulated task.
paragraphs.zh: 图 4 比较了无记忆多层感知机（MLP）PPO 智能体 [46] 与基于 LSTM 的循环 PPO 基线的训练曲线。 在相同的训练课程下，无记忆策略在三个入侵者情况下的成功率徘徊在约 10%，始终无法达到推进入侵者课程所需的 75% 成功率阈值。 相反，循环策略在每个课程阶段都超过了该阈值，并推进到最终的十个入侵者设置。 其回合长度也随着训练的进行而减少，这与生成越来越高效无人机（UAS）轨迹的策略相一致。 这证实了循环记忆对于在该仿真任务中实现有效导航是必不可少的。

paragraphs.en: Linear probes show that the actor’s LSTM hidden state contains information relevant to the navigation task, as summarised in Fig. 5 . The current ego position ( 𝒟 = 0.80 \mathcal{D}=0.80 - 0.86 0.86 ) and nearest-intruder range ( 𝒟 = 0.72 \mathcal{D}=0.72 ) are strongly decodable from recurrent memory. The next action achieves the highest score ( 𝒟 = 0.91 \mathcal{D}=0.91 ), since the policy head selects its action from the same hidden representation. The recurrent state also retains information that is no longer directly available in the current observation. Ego position and nearest-intruder range from 10 steps earlier remain strongly decodable ( 𝒟 = 0.72 \mathcal{D}=0.72 - 0.84 0.84 ), with decodability decreasing to 0.55 0.55 - 0.64 0.64 at a 30-step lag as expected for a gradually fading memory trace. Moreover, the future intruder range is decodable both 10 and 30 steps ahead ( 𝒟 = 0.70 \mathcal{D}=0.70 and 0.69 0.69 ). This suggests that the hidden state contains information about the evolving encounter geometry from which near-term separation can be predicted. These results therefore support interpreting the hidden state as a learned, task-dependent information state containing current, historical, and short-horizon predictive information.
paragraphs.zh: 线性探针表明，如图 5 所总结的，执行器的 LSTM 隐状态包含与导航任务相关的信息。 当前自机位置（𝒟=0.80-0.86）与最近入侵者距离（𝒟=0.72）可以从循环记忆中被强解码。 下一动作获得最高分数（𝒟=0.91），因为策略头从同一隐表示中选择其动作。 循环状态还保留了当前观测中已不再直接可用的信息。 10 步之前的自机位置与最近入侵者距离仍然可被强解码（𝒟=0.72-0.84），而在 30 步延迟下可解码性下降到 0.55-0.64，这符合逐渐消退的记忆痕迹的预期。 此外，未来入侵者距离在提前 10 步和 30 步时均可解码（𝒟=0.70 和 0.69）。 这表明隐状态包含关于不断演变的遭遇几何的信息，由此可以预测近期的间隔。 因此，这些结果支持将隐状态解读为一个习得的、依赖任务的信息状态，其中包含当前信息、历史信息和短期预测信息。

paragraphs.en: The largest and most consistent corrected gaps occur for policy-readout and past-world variables, whereas current-world variables generally exhibit smaller gaps. This pattern is consistent with new observations helping to reconstruct current quantities, while historical quantities remain dependent on retained recurrent context. Future-world gaps are smaller and more variable, particularly for interruptions with later onsets. At a later handback, the remaining mission horizon is short and targets often collapse toward the present, reducing the impact of an interruption. Overall, the predominantly positive gaps confirm that interruptions reduce the task-relevant information recoverable from recurrent memory after handback.
paragraphs.zh: 经校正后的最大且最一致的差距出现在策略读出与过去世界变量上，而当前世界变量的差距通常较小。 这一模式与以下情况一致：新的观测有助于重建当前量，而历史量仍依赖于保留的循环上下文。 未来世界的差距较小且更不稳定，对于发生较晚的中断尤其如此。 在较晚交还时，剩余任务时程很短，目标往往向当前收缩，从而降低了中断的影响。 总体而言，这些以正值为主的差距证实了中断会降低交还后从循环记忆中可恢复的任务相关信息。

Notably, this association remains after controlling for displacement, heading error, and nearest-intruder distance at handback, confirming that reduced decodability is associated with interruption-induced mission failures beyond what can be explained by physical deviations at handback.

paragraphs.en: The transplant study further isolates the contribution of the recurrent state. At handback, the interrupted arm’s actor recurrent state, comprising both hidden and cell states, is inserted into the matched reference arm while its physical state and current observation remain unchanged. This increases the post-handback collision rate by 4.6% and suggests that the recurrent state produced during an interruption can independently increase post-handback collision risk even when the physical handback state is held constant. Nonetheless, recurrent memory is not the only reason why interruptions affect performance. In fact, both the modified aircraft trajectory and the altered recurrent state contribute to degraded post-handback performance.
paragraphs.zh: 移植实验进一步分离了循环状态的贡献。 在交还时，被中断机组的智能体循环状态（包括隐藏状态和单元状态）被插入到匹配的参考机组中，而其物理状态和当前观测保持不变。 这使交还后的碰撞率增加了4.6%，表明即使物理交还状态保持不变，中断期间产生的循环状态也可以独立增加交还后的碰撞风险。 尽管如此，循环记忆并不是中断影响表现的唯一原因。 事实上，修改后的飞机轨迹和改变后的循环状态都会导致交还后表现的下降。

paragraphs.en: When supplying reference and interrupted arms identical observations after handback, the resulting command difference is illustrated in Fig. 8 , decomposed into contributions from the LSTM carried cell, candidate update, and gate activation signals. Carried cell content shows the largest contribution, confirming that accumulated context influences post-handback commands. Moreover, under identical observations, recurrent-state differences normalised by their initial value at handback continue to decrease, as illustrated in Fig. 9 . The reduction is substantially weaker in actual closed-loop flights, where each arm follows its own trajectory and receives different observations. These results support a feedback hypothesis, whereby altered memory changes commands, while changed commands and interruption-induced displacement alter subsequent observations. Those observations in turn update recurrent memory, which shapes later commands in a closed feedback loop. This loop can continually generate new recurrent-state differences and prolong post-handback disruption, even as the original interruption-time differences diminish.
paragraphs.zh: 当交还后向参考臂和中断臂提供相同的观测时，所产生的指令差异如图8所示，并分解为LSTM携带细胞、候选更新和门控激活信号的贡献。 携带细胞内容显示出最大的贡献，证实累积的上下文会影响交还后的指令。 此外，在相同观测下，以交还时初始值归一化的循环状态差异持续减小，如图9所示。 在实际闭环飞行中，这种减小明显较弱，因为每个智能体沿自己的轨迹飞行并接收不同的观测。 这些结果支持一个反馈假设，即记忆的改变会改变指令，而指令的改变和中断引起的位移又会改变后续的观测。 这些观测进而更新循环记忆，而循环记忆又塑造后续的指令，从而形成一个闭环反馈回路。 即使中断时刻的原始差异逐渐减小，这一回路仍能不断产生新的循环状态差异，并延长交还后的扰动。

sents.en: Those observations in turn update recurrent memory, which shapes later commands in a closed feedback loop.
sents.zh: 这些观测进而更新循环记忆，而循环记忆又塑造后续的指令，从而形成一个闭环反馈回路。

sents.en: This loop can continually generate new recurrent-state differences and prolong post-handback disruption, even as the original interruption-time differences diminish.

paragraphs.en: Fig. 11 shows that the lost-success rate increases from approximately 30% for four five-step segments, to 37% for two ten-step segments, and to 48% for one continuous 20-step interruption. paragraphs.en: Recurrent-memory degradation and interruption-induced mission harm for each architecture are summarised in Fig. 14 . All three interruption-aware architectures mitigate the impact of interruptions, resulting in lower recurrent state degradation and improved post-handback performance. This shorter persistence limits the action–observation feedback that may otherwise prolong post-handback disruption.

paragraphs.en: The results identify handback reliability as an additional safety requirement. Although the interruption may resolve an immediate hazard, it can degrade the policy’s recurrent state and reduce task-variable decodability, especially for historical variables that cannot be reconstructed from new observations. This can increase collision risk and degrade post-handback performance. Notably, this vulnerability extends beyond the handback instant. Carried cell content continues to influence commands, while changed commands and supervisor-induced displacement alter subsequent observations. Those observations update the memory used for later decisions, sustaining a post-handback disruption feedback loop. Recovery therefore depends on how recurrent context is used and updated when the agent regains authority.

paragraphs.en: The risk of an interruption varies with supervisor behaviour and interruption duration. Safety- and goal-directed supervisors generally cause fewer induced failures, but even helpful interruptions can cause reference successes to fail. Longer contiguous overrides are particularly disruptive as they allow recurrent state degradation to accumulate. Resetting memory and masking or freezing observations during an interruption provide no consistent improvement. Conversely, all three proposed interruption-aware architectures preserve more task-relevant information and improve post-handback performance, including under unseen supervisor behaviours. Explicit override context enables the proposed architectures to recalibrate how carried recurrent memory influences commands after handback. This shorter persistence can limit the action-observation feedback loop that otherwise prolongs post-handback disruption. Among the proposed designs, dual feature and gated architectures achieve the best performance, while the dual memory architecture performs less strongly but still improves substantially over the baseline. Dual memory’s weaker results may reflect its integration of interruption context at action selection, whereas the dual feature and gated architectures allow that context to directly shape how environmental memory is formed and updated.

paragraphs.en: The principal experiments use simplified two-dimensional dynamics, sensing, traffic and supervisor behaviours. Moreover, state-triggered evaluations and the single-operator human study only provide preliminary evidence of broader applicability. Higher-fidelity evaluation should incorporate three-dimensional dynamics, realistic surveillance and communication delays, standards-aligned safety functions, and more extensive human-in-the-loop trials. Additionally, the probes used in this study measure how readily task variables can be recovered from the recurrent hidden state. Lower decodability, however, does not necessarily imply that information has been irreversibly lost. Future work should combine non-linear probes with carefully controlled interruptions to clarify what information remains available and better study how it influences post-handback decisions. Further training seeds can also be leveraged for more robust results.

paragraphs.en: This paper characterises temporary overrides as a handback reliability problem for recurrent UAS navigation under partial observability. The problem is formulated as a PO-MAMDP that distinguishes nominally proposed actions from externally modified actions. Controlled experiments show that interruptions can reduce task-variable decodability, cause otherwise successful missions to fail, and increase collision risk through changes in the recurrent state. Notably, harm depends on supervisor behaviour and the longest contiguous interruption. Moreover, degradation is likely sustained through a post-handback feedback loop in which carried recurrent context influences commands and subsequent experience renews recurrent-state differences after handback.
paragraphs.zh: 本文将临时接管刻画为部分可观测条件下循环无人机系统（UAS）导航的交还可靠性问题。 该问题被建模为一个 PO-MAMDP，以区分名义上提出的动作与外部修改后的动作。 受控实验表明，中断会降低任务变量的可解码性，导致原本成功的任务失败，并通过改变循环状态而增加碰撞风险。 值得注意的是，危害取决于监督者的行为以及最长连续中断时长。 此外，性能退化很可能通过交还后的反馈回路得以持续：在该回路中，残留的循环上下文会影响指令，而后续经验又在交还后重新扩大循环状态的差异。

paragraphs.en: Three interruption-aware architectures are proposed to explicitly represent interruption context through separate feature streams, dedicated interruption memory, or gated environmental features. Under scheduled interruptions, the strongest evaluated design reduces post-handback collision harm by 74% and interruption-induced lost successes by 69% relative to the recurrent baseline, without degrading interruption-free performance. State-triggered and pilot-generated tests provide preliminary evidence that these benefits extend beyond scheduled supervisor behaviour.

paragraphs.en: These findings establish handback reliability as a distinct reliability concern for recurrent autonomy. Future work should assess robustness across training seeds and higher-fidelity environments, explore solutions that recover incorrect carried recurrent context, and explore the impact of interruptions on different learning algorithms and recurrent architectures. Moreover, future research should investigate the impact of interruptions in hierarchical and multi-agent navigation settings.
